contract.says: every call meets `len(arr) <= 10 && all(i < len(arr): arr[i] <= 15)`

variant_answers.text: arr may be any sequence of integers (list, tuple, array.array, ...), and the function must accept all of them.
Only non-empty arrays are covered; the behaviour for [] is unspecified (don't care).
The function computes and outputs (e.g. prints) the minimum number; its return value is not constrained.
The result is any numeric value equal to the minimum count (e.g. the float 4.0 also satisfies `== 4`).

variant_answers.phrase: read the same backwards and forwards
variant_answers.text: Textually: the written form of the array (e.g. the concatenated decimal digits) reads the same reversed (so [10, 1], written 101, is palindromic).
